questions.qtext: A cube is painted red on all faces and it is cut into 125 smaller cubes of equal size.

options.text: Number of cubes those are not painted = 18
Number of cubes whose 3 faces are painted = 8
Number of cubes whose 2 faces are painted = 36
Number of cubes with 1 face painted = 54

questions.solution:
(b, c, d)
1. Number of cubes which have three faces painted = 8 (because 8 corners)
2. Number of cubes wihich have two faces painted = (5 – 2) × No. of edges = (5 – 2) × 12 = 36
3. Number of cubes which have one face painted = (5 – 2)2 × 6 = 54
4. Number of cubes with no faces painted = (5 – 2)3 × 6 = 27 (Interior cubes)

questions.qtext: Which of the following statement(s) is/are CORRECT regarding Hume-Rothery’s rule for extensive solid solubility?

options.text: Crystal structure of both the elements should be the same.
Difference in atomic radii between the two elements should be greater than 15%.
The chemical affinity between the elements should be higher.
An element of lower valency can dissolves more amount of another element of higher valency.

questions.solution:
(a, d)
The difference in atomic radii between the two elements should be less than 15% for extensive solid solubility.
